outline:
先修課程：半導體元件物理、高等IC製程
探討奈米矽元件之物理模型，及物理極限之深層探討。
schedule:
✧ Introduction (1st week)
✧ Basic Semiconductor Physics (2nd week)
✧ Nano-Metal Physics (3rd week)
✧ Nano-Si Device (4~ 5th weeks)
✧ Basic theorems (6th week)
✧ Basic Quantum Mechanics (7~ 8th weeks)
Mid-term Exam. (9th week)
✧ Postulates of Quantum Mechanics (10th week)
✧ Time independent Schrödinger wave equation (11th week)
✧ Matrix formulation of Quantum Mechanics (12~ 13th weeks)
✧ Lattice vibrations and their quantization (14~ 15th weeks)
✧ Electromagnetic fields and their quantization (16th week)
✧ Waveguide in nano-Si Device (17th week)
Final Exam. (18th week)
scorePolicy:
Grading:
1.Midterm Exam.: 20%
2.Final Exam: 30%
3.Technical Report or term project: 50%
a.Total pages > 30 pages
b.Can not copy all of sections from some papers or related published documents
c.Reference lists > 30 items
